role: General Manager of Milwaukee County's Park Commission
stance_basis: statement confirms recommended corridor does not interfere with any present or proposed park development
summary: Howard Gregg, General Manager of Milwaukee County's Park Commission, submitted a statement through Milwaukee County Transportation Director R. W. Brannan indicating that the recommended corridor location for the Airport Spur does not interfere with any present or proposed park development. His statement was entered into the record at the March 25, 1969 Corridor Location Public Hearing. No concerns or objections were raised, and no response was deemed necessary.
complaint_summary: Howard Gregg's statement, submitted through R. W. Brannan, affirmed that the recommended corridor location does not interfere with any present or proposed park development.
